Zaril's chat table, block by block

Every chat block of Zaril's party as the game plays it now (the current English build, disc 756d4fb0, main 4a53dc4), from the emulator. Each block was forced in turn; block 1 is the second Talk press. Every page of every reply is shown, with the text on screen repeated below it. The topic line stays on the bottom bar while the replies play. Blocks 0 and 2-13 each come up 1 time in 13 (docs/re/bugs.md 2.10).
